_meta.title: Drishyam counting module: models, services, logic, data flow
_meta.date: 2026-10-27 (gate line made any-angle the same day)
_meta.purpose: Reference for refactoring the Gate Activity Matrix and letting a gate line be drawn at any angle
_meta.paths: Relative to repo root. Line refs are file:line.

data_flow.summary: Head-count PUSHES live occupancy to the backend. Footfall and activity-monitor are PULL-only, and the backend proxies them. There is no realtime count socket: the frontend polls everything.

occupancy: head-count :8020 (YOLOv8 head, confirmed tracks, zone point-in-polygon)
backend: Redis occupancy:live:<monitorId> (30 s TTL) + occ:acc minute hash
aggregator: occupancy_camera_minute (60 s), then occupancy_space_rollup 15m/1h/1d (5 min)
fuse.js gives the room count; evaluator (10 s) opens incidents and emits occupancy.* ai.event
frontend: GET /spaces/live, /occupancy/history, /occupancy/summary; head-count /streams polled directly every 1.5 s
footfall_gate: vms_face :8001 (SCRFD face boxes, or YOLOv8n ONNX person boxes when PIPELINE_PERSON_DETECTION_ENABLED)
services/footfall.py: centroid tracker; cross-product side test against segment a-b (any angle), dead band, min 3 frames, 1 s re-count cooldown
frontend useOccupancy: /footfall/cameras every 5 s, /footfall/timeseries hourly every 60 s
crowd_zone: backend zoneIntrusion.service.js (feet point in polygon, maxOccupancy capacity mode)
attendance_line: crossing.py: line at any angle, cross-product side test
pipelines.config_down: Every AI service polls GET /api/internal/cameras for settings.headcount.{enabled, threshold, zones, imgsz}. Footfall config lives in AI Postgres cameras.config_json.footfall, not in the backend.

models.counts: Confirmed tracks: 2 hits at least 0.3 s apart, or one hit at conf >= 0.65. A track expires after 2 misses or 6 s. Static tracks are excluded.

gate_activity_matrix.row_builder: occupancy-data.js:163-188 (keeps only footfall_enabled, sorted by in descending)

gate_line.stored: AI Postgres cameras.config_json.footfall = {enabled, line:{a,b}, direction, falls_enabled, line_y_frac(echo)}

crossing.point: feet (bottom-centre) for YOLO person boxes, box centre for face boxes; never mixed on one camera
crossing.side_test: s = (bx-ax)*(py-ay) - (by-ay)*(px-ax); s > 0 = right of a->b in image coords (y down)
crossing.segment_only: counts only if the step crosses between a and b (+ half a box width slack)
crossing.in_then_out: one track counts both directions (old once-per-track latch removed)

gate_line.legacy: line_y_frac y -> a=[0,y], b=[1,y]; down_is_in -> right_is_in, up_is_in -> left_is_in (relative to the line orientation)
gate_line.live_reconfig: PUT is forwarded to the shard that owns the camera; orchestrator reads the registry each frame, so enabling a gate needs no camera restart
gate_line.editor: GateCanvas: drag an end to turn/stretch, drag the line to move, press-drag elsewhere to draw a new one (ordered left->right), arrow keys move a focused end

known_issues: Day boundaries are UTC midnight (routes/footfall.py:51-55), but users are on IST.
Backend coerces heads to 0 before the quality check (internal.routes.js:190), and peopleCount uses Number(heads)||0. Both break the NULL-means-unknown rule.
The overlay route drops compact frames (v:2, b[]) from vms_face (internal.routes.js:317-326).
occupancy_space_minute is never written. The rollup's space_id actually holds camera_id. timeOverCapacityMin is always 0.
The restricted-zone API cannot set maxOccupancy.
No socket event carries live counts: everything is polled.
